name: ask-codex
description: A Claude Code plugin that turns OpenAI Codex into a teammate for code review, plan validation, refactors, and implementations with automatic GPT-6.1 routing, driven through the Codex CLI.

plugins.name: ask-codex
plugins.description: Delegate coding work from Claude Code to OpenAI Codex through the Codex CLI (codex exec) with GPT-6.1 Sol by default, Terra/Luna for cheaper work, Astra for the hardest cases, and multi-turn codex-teammate loops when needed.
